issue_context.title: Nanoleaf - logfile - unavailable messages flood the log
issue_context.body:
### The problem

If a configured nanoleaf shape instance is unplugged, while HA start, the logfile is filled with errors.

Like Frenck has done for WLED already, it is more useful, that the error message appears one time and then the configuration procedure go into back ground without filling the logs any longer ...



### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.9.6

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

na

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

nanoleaf

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/nanoleaf

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
na
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
# first time
2021-09-13 09:33:08 ERROR (SyncWorker_9) [pynanoleaf.pynanoleaf] 10.10.0.173 is not available
2021-09-13 09:33:08 WARNING (MainThread) [homeassistant.config_entries] Config entry 'Shapes XYZZ' for nanoleaf integration not ready yet: 10.10.0.173 is not available; Retrying in background
...
2021-09-13 09:33:20 ERROR (SyncWorker_1) [pynanoleaf.pynanoleaf] 10.10.0.173 is not available
2021-09-13 09:33:32 ERROR (SyncWorker_0) [pynanoleaf.pynanoleaf] 10.10.0.173 is not available
...
2021-09-13 09:37:20 ERROR (SyncWorker_4) [pynanoleaf.pynanoleaf] 10.10.0.173 is not available
2021-09-13 09:38:42 ERROR (SyncWorker_0) [pynanoleaf.pynanoleaf] 10.10.0.173 is not available
...
2021-09-13 09:46:54 ERROR (SyncWorker_3) [pynanoleaf.pynanoleaf] 10.10.0.173 is not available
2021-09-13 09:48:16 ERROR (SyncWorker_0) [pynanoleaf.pynanoleaf] 10.10.0.173 is not available
...
2021-09-13 10:19:42 ERROR (SyncWorker_6) [pynanoleaf.pynanoleaf] 10.10.0.173 is not available
2021-09-13 10:21:04 ERROR (SyncWorker_0) [pynanoleaf.pynanoleaf] 10.10.0.173 is not available
...
```


### Additional information

_No response_
comments:
Hey there @milanmeu, mind taking a look at this issue as it has been labeled with an integration (`nanoleaf`) you are listed as a [code owner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L330) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

Thank you for reporting this @S-Przybylski.

The errors do not come from the Home Assistant integration but from the `pynanoleaf` library.

Because there are higher priority issues with the Nanoleaf integration at the moment, I don't expect this to be changed before 2021.10 but it is on my list: https://github.com/users/milanmeu/projects/2#card-67372636.

Until this is fixed, you can disable the library logs by adding the following to your `configuration.yaml`:
```yaml
logger:
  default: info
  logs:
    pynanoleaf.pynanoleaf: fatal
```
This will only disable pynanoleaf communication errors, logs created by the integration are not effected.

I'm sorry I can't help you right away, but I hope you understand.
I'll keep you posted here.
